page.lede: Ask the feedback of this Research a question. Voce counts how many mention it and answers with the customers' exact words.

nothingToAsk.titleEmpty: This is where you'll ask your feedback questions and read the answers in customers' own words.
nothingToAsk.bodyEmpty: You need feedback to get an answer. Add some from the public form, a CSV, or by pasting it in.

form.label: Your question
form.hint: Enter to ask, Shift+Enter for a new line.

errors.empty: Write a question before sending it. For example: what do customers say about pricing?
errors.tooLong: The question is over 300 characters: shorten it to a single request.
errors.busy: A question is already in progress, maybe from another tab. Wait a few seconds and try again.
errors.network: Can't reach Voce: check your connection and try again. If the question had already been sent, it counts toward this month's questions.
errors.sessionText: Your session has expired. Log in again to ask the question.
errors.noFeedbackText: There's no more feedback in this Research to answer from.
errors.notFoundText: I can't find this Research: it may have been deleted.

failed.zero: The answer didn't come through. The question still counts: you've used all your questions for {month}.
failed.rest: The answer didn't come through. The question still counts toward the month: {left, plural, one {you have 1 question left for {month}} other {you have {left} questions left for {month}}}. Try again shortly.

quotaNote.first: You'll use 1 of your {quota} questions for {month}.
quotaNote.left: {left, plural, one {You have 1 question left for {month}.} other {You have {left} questions left for {month}.}}

limitNotice.title: You've used all {quota} questions for {month}
limitNotice.free: With Pro you get {proLimit} a month. Otherwise they're available again on {nextMonth} 1.

slow: This is taking longer than usual. The answer is coming: stay on this page.
count: {count, plural, one {feedback mentions it} other {feedback mention it}}

summary.noEvidence: No feedback mentions it. Read {count} feedback of this Research.

answer.heading: Answer to “{question}”
answer.noEvidenceBody: Read {count} feedback of this Research. Try different words, for example the feature name the way customers write it.
answer.perimeterPartial: Read the {considered} most recent feedback of this Research, out of {total}: older ones aren't part of the answer.
answer.copiedStatus: Answer copied: question, answer and quotes with their sources.
answer.copyFailed: Can't copy from here: select the text and copy it by hand.
answer.session: Answers stay here until you reload the page. To keep one, use Copy.

suggest.title: Try asking
suggest.hypothesisRefuted: Who still says that “{text}”, and why?
suggest.hypothesisOpen: Who confirms and who disagrees that “{text}”?
suggest.themeProblem: What do customers ask for to fix “{title}”?
suggest.themeOpportunity: What exactly do customers ask about “{title}”?
suggest.starterAsk: What do customers ask for most often?
suggest.starterProblem: What do customers complain about most?

followUp.label: Dig deeper
followUp.solutionsQuestion: On “{question}”: what do customers suggest as a fix?
followUp.oppositeQuestion: On “{question}”: who says the opposite, and why?
followUp.othersQuestion: How many other customers say that “{quote}”?

progress.read: {count, plural, one {Reading the only feedback of this Research} other {Reading the {count} feedback of this Research}}
progress.readPartial: Reading the {count} most recent feedback of this Research
progress.search: Looking for the ones that answer the question
progress.check: Checking that every quote is exactly what the customer wrote

clipboard.question: Question: {question}
clipboard.noEvidence: No feedback mentions it, out of {count} read.
